reason: Local preview and deploy classification are ready, but backend/server mutation still requires explicit deployment-phase approval.

phases.title: Approval and backup
required: Get explicit human approval for deployment scope.
Back up backend-managed content and target server files.

phases.title: Same-path overwrite candidates
required: Smoke test affected pages after upload.

phases.title: Backend-managed downloads
required: Do not blindly overwrite /file/download or /file/output routes.
Verify every changed download link from frontend.

phases.title: CSS relative assets
required: Keep assets with CSS bundle or remap paths during deployment.
Verify icons, social buttons, search icons, and fonts.

phases.title: Site static assets
required: Confirm cache-busting behavior if replacing existing files.

phases.title: Excluded local placeholders
required: Resolve source mapping if the visible page needs the asset.

smokeTests: Open homepage, one product category, one product detail, and one service page on desktop.
Check no broken images and no horizontal overflow.
Check canonical, H1, breadcrumb, and visible CTA remain intact.
rollback: If smoke test fails, stop broad deployment.
Restore backed-up server files and backend content.
Re-run the same smoke test set after rollback.
